_comment: Notional value of each conversion action, in GBP ex VAT. The pipeline stores RAW COUNTS only; values are applied when the dashboard renders. So if you change a value here, the entire history is re-rated consistently and the trend stays honest. 'success_rate' is the share of button clicks you assume go on to complete (1.0 = the value already accounts for drop-off, which is how the original Thrums setup worked). 'slot' is the fixed colour slot: a conversion type keeps its colour on every dashboard, always. An event_map entry can be a plain GA4 event name, or a rule object using GA4's own enhanced-measurement events: {"event":"page_view","page_path_contains":"/thank-you"}, {"event":"form_submit","page_path_contains":"/register"}, {"event":"click","link_url_contains":"vetsuccess.co.uk"}. Rules have full history in GA4, so they survive site changes that break GTM triggers.
